events.verdict: Towns (NYK) is moving to align alongside Curry's (GSW) path and marginal body contact occurs as the two come together after Curry's gather. Separately, Anunoby (NYK) legally contests Curry's driving shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) brings his left hand forward and marginal contact occurs with Green's (GSW) right arm after Green retrieves the rebound and releases the put-back attempt.
Curry (GSW) cleanly blocks McBride's (NYK) shot attempt as simultaneous marginal body contact occurs.
McBride (NYK) falls to the floor following his shot attempt and incidental contact occurs thereafter as Green (GSW) steps toward him.
Hart (NYK) and Payton II (GSW) come together at the same point as they each pursue the rebound and incidental contact occurs.
Anunoby (NYK) turns away from Curry (GSW) after gaining control of the rebound and marginal body contact occurs.
Payton II (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Towns (NYK) prior to incidental contact occurring.
Towns (NYK) moves into Green (GSW) and initiates body contact that affects Green's SQBR following the change of possession.

Payton II (GSW) releases his right hand away from Bridges' (NYK) side as the pick approaches and the contact is marginal. Simultaneously, Payton II and Bridges make incidental foot contact with one another.
Green (GSW) initiates contact across Bridges' (NYK) right arm and causes him to lose control of the ball.
Payton II (GSW) and Bridges (NYK) make incidental contact with one another as they each attempt to gain control of the deflected inbound pass.
McBride (NYK) makes incidental foot contact with Curry (GSW) as Curry sets the pick.
Towns (NYK) moves to align alongside Green's (GSW) path and the contact during Green's drive to the basket is marginal.
Bridges (NYK) re-establishes in bounds before gaining control of the pass.
Payton II (GSW) and Green (GSW) each legally contest Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) cleanly deflects the ball away from Curry (GSW) during the rebound prior to any incidental contact occurring.
Curry (GSW) initiates contact across Anunoby's (NYK) arm, subsequently allowing him to then make contact with the ball during Anunoby's upward shooting motion.
McBride (NYK) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Towns (NYK) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Moody (GSW) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
